narrative.details:
<Magistrate Solomon sighs.>

You must return to the Burning Steppes, adventurer. As a deputy of Stormwind, you will be required to report to Marshal Maxwell. Good luck.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes.

chain.subtitle: 16 quests from level 54 to 60, 77,300 XP in all.

quests.name: Dragonkin Menace
quests.objectiveText: Slay 15 Black Broodlings, 10 Black Dragonspawn, 4 Black Wyrmkin and 1 Black Drake.

quests.name: The True Masters
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Lakeshire and deliver Helendis Riverhorn's Letter to Magistrate Solomon.

quests.name: The True Masters
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Stormwind and deliver Solomon's Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. Bolvar resides in Stormwind Keep.

quests.name: The True Masters
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon after speaking with Lady Katrana Prestor.

quests.name: The True Masters
quests.objectiveText: Take Bolvar's Decree to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.

quests.name: The True Masters
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: The True Masters
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Ragged John to learn of Marshal Windsor's fate and return to Marshal Maxwell when you have completed this task. You recall Marshal Maxwell telling you to search for h

quests.name: Marshal Windsor
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Mountain in the northwest and enter Blackrock Depths.

quests.name: Abandoned Hope
quests.objectiveText: Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.

quests.name: A Crumpled Up Note
quests.objectiveText: You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing.

quests.name: A Shred of Hope
quests.objectiveText: Return Marshal Windsor's Lost Information. Marshal Windsor believes that the information is being held by Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge.

quests.name: Jail Break!
quests.objectiveText: Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends.

quests.name: Stormwind Rendezvous
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates.

quests.name: The Dragon's Eye
quests.objectiveText: You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye.

quests.name: Drakefire Amulet
quests.objectiveText: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath.
